Description

The first edition, first printing of The Bugatti Story by L’ebé Bugatti, the daughter of Ettore Bugatti.
Octavo, xii, 196pp. Blue cloth, title stamped in black on spine. Stated “First Edition” on the copyright page. Appears unread. In the publisher’s fine dust jacket, $5.25 on the front flap, bright illustrations. Jacket design by Harry Eaby and Milton Sanders.
The Bugatti Story by L’Ébé Bugatti is a biography of Ettore Bugatti, the legendary automobile designer, written by his daughter. The book details his life, innovations, and the history of the Bugatti brand, covering the development of iconic models and the family’s legacy.
